settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Turn features on or off to fit how your shop works.

toggles.enableMultiUnitHelp: Turn on if you buy or sell in more than one unit, like piece and dozen.
toggles.enableCustomerDueHelp: Turn on if you let customers buy now and pay later.
toggles.enableBarcodeHelp: Turn on if you scan barcodes at checkout.
toggles.enableProductVariantHelp: Turn on if products come in sizes or colors, like clothing or shoes.
toggles.enableComboOfferHelp: Turn on if you run bundle deals, like "buy 2 get 1 free".
toggles.enableMultiLocationHelp: Turn on if you have more than one branch or warehouse.
toggles.allowNegativeStockHelp: Turn on if a sale should go through even when the system shows zero stock (stock will show as negative until corrected).
toggles.enableTaxHelp: Turn on if you charge VAT or tax on sales.

fields.maxCustomerDueLimitHelp: You'll get a warning when a customer's due balance would go past this amount. Leave blank for no limit.
fields.maxCustomerDueLimitNonNegative: Must be zero or a positive number.
fields.defaultTaxRateHelp: Applied to sales unless a product has its own rate.
fields.defaultTaxRateNonNegative: Must be zero or a positive number.
